Read in Species Parameters
```{r}
external_species_info <- read.csv("Ess_data/new_ESS_species_params.csv") |>
  select(-beta) |>
  rename(beta = min_ppmr) |>
  select(Species, w_max, w_mat, w_min, l_mat, beta, sigma, a, b, age_mat)|>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 2)))

species_lookup <- c(
  "Gadus morhua"                 = "Atlantic Cod",
  "Melanogrammus aeglefinus"     = "Haddock",
  "Urophycis tenuis"             = "White Hake",
  "Merluccius bilinearis"        = "Silver Hake",
  "Pollachius virens"            = "Pollock",
  "Sebastes fasciatus"           = "Redfish Unseparated",
  "Reinhardtius hippoglossoides" = "Greenland Halibut",
  "Hippoglossoides platessoides" = "American Plaice",
  "Glyptocephalus cynoglossus"   = "Witch Flounder",
  "Myzopsetta ferruginea"           = "Yellowtail Flounder",
  "Clupea harengus"              = "Atlantic Herring",
  "Mallotus villosus"            = "Capelin",
  "Scomber scombrus"             = "Mackerel",
  "Squalus acanthias"            = "Spiny Dogfish",
  "Ammodytes dubius"             = "Sand Lance",
  "Hippoglossus hippoglossus"    = "Atlantic Halibut"
)

species_order <- c(
  "Atlantic Cod", "Haddock", "White Hake", "Silver Hake","Pollock", "Redfish Unseparated", "Greenland Halibut","American Plaice", "Witch Flounder", "Yellowtail Flounder","Atlantic Herring", "Capelin", "Mackerel", "Spiny Dogfish", "Sand Lance", "Atlantic Halibut")

external_species_info <- external_species_info |> mutate(Species = recode(Species, !!!species_lookup)) |>
  filter(Species %in% species_order) |> mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = species_order)) |>
  arrange(Species) |> mutate(Species = as.character(Species))

names(external_species_info)[1] <- "species"

years_to_use<-as.character(1970:1985) #Assign years for the reference period

```

Read in catch data/Subset and average the catch data 

```{r}
catches <- readRDS("Ess_data/new_catches_nafo.RDS")
catches <- catches[as.character(1970:2022), ]
# convert matrix → data.frame
catches <- as.data.frame(catches)
yield_ts <- catches |> rownames_to_column("Year") |>
pivot_longer(-Year, names_to = "Species", values_to = "Yield") |>
mutate(Year = as.numeric(Year), Yield = ifelse(is.na(Yield), 0, Yield) )

```

Aggregate to mean observed yield between 1970 and 1985 
```{r}
#Aggregate to mean observed catch 
mean_catch_nafo <- subset(yield_ts, Year <= max(years_to_use)) %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarise(yield_observed = mean(Yield, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(factor(Species, levels = new_order))

mean_catch_nafo

# set sandlance catches to NA; assume not fished (only sporadic catches)
mean_catch_nafo$yield_observed[15] <-NA

```


Read in Biomass from DFO RV Survey (from Alidy Bundy, 4VW only)
convert from KG??? to grams (need to check with Alida Bundy to be sure)
Restrict to the 9 species of interest
Rename columns
```{r}
#Read observed biomass: DFO (Bundy et al., 2017)
biomass_obs <- read.csv("Ess_data/Alida_Qadj_Biomass.csv")   # Q adjusted Biomass
#biomass_obs <- read.csv("Ess_data/Alida_notQadj_biomass.csv") # NoT Q adjusted Biomass
# convert to grams
biomass_obs[, -1] <- biomass_obs[, -1] * 1e3

# rename columns using exact gsub output, then fix manually
colnames(biomass_obs) <- gsub("\\.", " ", colnames(biomass_obs))
colnames(biomass_obs) <- trimws(colnames(biomass_obs))         # remove trailing spaces
colnames(biomass_obs) <- gsub("\\s+", " ", colnames(biomass_obs))  # collapse double spaces

# fix remaining mismatches
colnames(biomass_obs)[colnames(biomass_obs) == "Redfish Unseparated"]  <- "Redfishes Unseparated"
colnames(biomass_obs)[colnames(biomass_obs) == "Short fin Squid"]      <- "Shortfin Squid"
colnames(biomass_obs)[colnames(biomass_obs) == "NA"]                   <- "Unknown"

# verify all names
colnames(biomass_obs)

# remove unwanted species
biomass_obs <- biomass_obs %>%
  select(-any_of(c(
    "Winter Flounder", "Barndoor Skate", "Argentine", "Longhorn Sculpin",
    "Thorny Skate", "Monkfish", "Winter Skate", "Shad American",
    "Sharks Unspecified", "Pandalus borealis", "Butterfish",
    "Shortfin Squid", "Holothuroidea", "Sea Cucumber", "Unknown"
  )))

biomass_obs[is.na(biomass_obs)] <- 0

```

Aggregate to mean biomass between 1970 and 1985
```{r}
#Aggregate observed biomass to mean biomass
biomass_obs_sub = subset(biomass_obs, Year < 2023)
biomass_ts<-melt(biomass_obs_sub,id.vars = 1)
names(biomass_ts)<-c("Year","Species","Biomass")

mean_biomass_obs <- subset(biomass_ts, Year<=max(years_to_use))%>%
  group_by(Species)%>%
  summarise(biomass_observed =mean(Biomass,  na.rm = T))
mean_biomass_obs$biomass_observed<- ifelse(is.nan( mean_biomass_obs$biomass_observed),NA,  mean_biomass_obs$biomass_observed)


```

Copy species life history parameters into the species parameters for the model
```{r}

external_species_info<-select(external_species_info,c("species","w_max","w_mat", "w_min","beta" ,"sigma" ,"a","b","age_mat", "biomass_observed", "yield_observed"))
# Create a Mizer multispecies parameter object using species traits and gear settings.
# - interaction = NULL: use default interaction matrix (intra = 1, inter = 0.2)
# - kappa = 1e8: sets background resource carrying capacity
# - gear_params: provides fishing gear selectivity and catchability
params <- newMultispeciesParams(external_species_info,interaction = NULL, kappa = 1e8, gear_params = gear_params)

```


Read the fishing history data/set fishing into params from NAFO
set intial effort as mean_effort
```{r}
# Load time-varying fishing effort data (relative effort by gear or species)
fishing_history <- readRDS("Ess_data/new_relative_interp_effort_nafo.RDS")

# Subset effort data for the years 1970 to 2010
effort <- fishing_history[as.character("1970":"2022"), ]

# Calculate the mean effort over selected years (defined in `years_to_use`)
# This assumes `years_to_use` is a vector of years like 1970:1984
mean_effort <- apply(effort[years_to_use, ], 2, mean, na.rm = TRUE)

# Set initial fishing effort in the model to the average over the reference period
# This ensures a steady-state calibration baseline
initial_effort(params) <- unlist(mean_effort)

```

set up initial catchability using this mean relative effort and catchability of 1 as initial value only - BUT WILL ESTIMARE LATER
```{r}
#assume catchability of 1, will be estimated further down
gear_params(params)$catchability <- rep(1.0,16)
gear_params(params)$yield_observed <- mean_catch_nafo$yield_observed

```

Biomass cutoff from length distributions
```{r}
# read data
lengthfreq <- read.csv("Ess_data/Alida_Qadj_biomass_at_Length.csv.csv")  #Q adjusted
#lengthfreq <- read.csv("Ess_data/Alida_not_Qadj_biomass_at_Length.csv). # not Adjusted
lengthfreq <- lengthfreq %>%
  select(YEAR, Species_name = SPECIES_NAME, LENGTH, ABUNDANCE) %>%
  rename(length_cm = LENGTH)

# Remove unwanted species first
remove_species <- c(
  "Winter Flounder", "Barndoor Skate", "Argentine", "Longhorn Sculpin",
  "Thorny Skate", "Monkfish", "Winter Skate", "Shad American",
  "Sharks (Unspecified)", "Pandalus borealis", "Butterfish",
  "Short-Fin Squid", "Holothuroidea", "Sea Cucumber")

lengthfreq <- lengthfreq %>%
  mutate(Species_name = trimws(Species_name)) %>%
  filter(!Species_name %in% remove_species & !is.na(Species_name))

# Filter by year BEFORE averaging (while YEAR still exists)
lengthfreq <- lengthfreq %>%
  filter(YEAR <= max(years_to_use))

# Now compute mean abundance per length (averaging over years)
lengthfreq <- lengthfreq %>%
  group_by(YEAR, Species_name, length_cm) %>%
  summarise(meanN = mean(ABUNDANCE, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Pivot wider keeping YEAR as an id variable alongside length_cm
lengthfreq_wide <- lengthfreq %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Species_name, values_from = meanN)

# Define desired species order (matching your species_params order)
species_order <- c(
  "Atlantic Cod", "Haddock", "White Hake", "Silver Hake", "Pollock",
  "Redfishes Unseparated", "Greenland Halibut", "American Plaice",
  "Witch Flounder", "Yellowtail Flounder", "Atlantic Herring",
  "Capelin", "Mackerel", "Spiny Dogfish", "Sand Lance", "Atlantic Halibut"
)

# Reorder keeping YEAR and length_cm first
lengthfreq_wide <- lengthfreq_wide %>%
  select(YEAR, length_cm, all_of(species_order))


# Melt back, preserving both YEAR and length_cm
lengthfreq <- melt(lengthfreq_wide, id.vars = c("YEAR", "length_cm"))

# Now YEAR exists and can be filtered
lengthfreq <- lengthfreq %>%
  filter(YEAR <= max(years_to_use)) %>%
  group_by(variable, length_cm) %>%
  summarise(meanN = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()
# ----------------------------
# 5. Plot length spectra
# ----------------------------
p <- ggplot(lengthfreq, aes(x=log10(length_cm),y=log10(meanN), group=variable)) + 
  geom_line()+
  facet_wrap(~variable)
p
biomass_cutoff<- lengthfreq |> 
  filter(meanN>=0) |>
  group_by(variable) |> 
  summarise(min_l=min(length_cm),max_l=max(length_cm))|> 
  mutate(Species=species_params(params)$species,min_w=round(species_params(params)$a*min_l^species_params(params)$b,1),max_w=round(species_params(params)$a*max_l^species_params(params)$b,1))|>
  select(Species,min_l,max_l,min_w,max_w)|>
  ungroup()
external_species_info$biomass_cutoff <- biomass_cutoff$min_w

# adjust max_w for some species (too small max_w from RFishBase)
# ratio<-biomass_cutoff$max_w/species_params(params)$w_max
# corrections<-which(ratio>1)
# 
# external_species_info[corrections,"w_max"]<-biomass_cutoff[which(ratio>1),"max_w"]
# #correct sandlance maturation size too
# external_species_info[15,"w_mat"]<-external_species_info[15,"w_max"]*0.10
external_species_info
```

Include  more realistic interaction matrix: 
no predation on Alt. Halibut
guild feeding

```{r}
params_spp_interactions<-params

inter<-interaction_matrix(params_spp_interactions)
inter[]<-0.5
diag(inter)<-0.2

#inter["Atlantic Cod",cAtlantic Herring", "Sand Lances")]<-1.0

#  # Define guilds 

# Loosely based  DFO report Cook & Bndy 2010 (Table 4.1.1):
# Cod prefer both sandlances & herring + other fish
# White hake prefers herring
# Flatfish no herring, but prefer sandlances, heavy reliance on resource

     piscivores = c("Atlantic Cod", "Spiny Dogfish", "White Hake", "Atlantic Halibut","Greenland Halibut")
     benthivores = c("Haddock", "American Plaice", "Yellowtail Flounder", "Witch Flounder")
     pelagics =  c("Atlantic Herring", "Sand Lances","Silver Hake","Atlantic Redfishes")
     
#    Set species interaction strengths
     inter[piscivores, pelagics] <- 0.8  # Strong preference for pelagics
     inter[piscivores, benthivores] <- 0.6 # Moderate preference for benthivores
     inter[piscivores, piscivores] <- 0.6  # Moderate preference for piscivores

#    Benthivores interact more within guild
     inter[benthivores, pelagics] <- 0.1  # Weak preference for pelagics
     inter[benthivores, benthivores] <- 0.8 # Strong preference for other benthivores
     inter[benthivores,  piscivores] <- 0.1  # Weak preference for piscivores

# Species-specific rules, less predation on herring for some piscivores
     inter["White Hake", "Sand Lances"] <- 0.2 # less benthic than other piscivores
     inter[c("Greenland Halibut","Atlantic Halibut"), "Atlantic Herring"] <- 0.2  # less pelagic than other piscivores
     inter["Haddock ", c(piscivores,benthivores) ] <- 0.5 # more gadoid predation than other benthivores
     inter[, "Greenland Halibut"] <- 0  # only a few predators on large halibuts, due to handling diffculties
     inter[c("Atlantic Cod", "Spiny Dogfish", "White Hake", "Atlantic Halibut","Greenland Halibut"), "Greenland Halibut"] <- 0.5  # only a few predators on large halibuts, due to handling diffculties
     inter[, "Atlantic Halibut"] <- 0.0  # only a few predators on large halibuts
     inter[c("Atlantic Cod", "Spiny Dogfish", "White Hake", "Atlantic Halibut","Greenland Halibut"), "Atlantic Halibut"] <- 0.5  # only a few predators on large halibuts
 
#input interaction matrics to params
params<-setInteraction(params,inter)

```

Run params to steady state
```{r}
# Plot initial model spectra (before running steady state)
# `power = 2` rescales biomass densities to approximate weight-based biomass (biomass ~ N * w^2)
plotSpectra(params, power = 2)

# Run the model to steady state: iterates until no major change in biomass over time
params <- steady(params)

# Plot resulting spectra using Plotly (interactive)
# Useful to check for unrealistic kinks or mismatches in species/resource structure
plotlySpectra(params, power = 2)
```


Rescale Species Spectra, Rince and repeat (till convergence is achieved in 1.5 years)
```{r}
# Iteratively improve the calibration by adjusting model parameters
# to better match observed biomasses, and then re-solving for steady state
for (i in 1:20) {
  params <- params |> 
    matchBiomasses() |>  # Adjust species parameters to better match observed biomasses
    steady()             # Recalculate the steady-state solution
}
```

could use to the below plot instead to check ratio is within +/- 1.2 model biomass/observed biomass for all species (I stopped when Total Relative Error was 0.385)
```{r}
# Plot comparison of model-predicted vs observed biomass
# - ratio = TRUE: plots the ratio (model / observed), ideal value is 1
# - labels = FALSE: do not display species names on the plot
plotBiomassObservedVsModel(params, ratio = TRUE, labels = FALSE)

# Plot comparison of model-predicted vs observed yield (catch)
# - ratio = TRUE: shows how well the model predicts catch relative to observed data
# - labels = FALSE: cleaner plot without species labels
plotYieldObservedVsModel(params, ratio = TRUE, labels = FALSE)

# Plot interactive feeding level by size for each species
# Shows how close species are to satiation (values near 1 = full, <0.2 = hungry)
# Useful to check realism of trophic dynamics and possible starvation
plotlyFeedingLevel(params)

```      


View Spectra
```{r}
# Plot the model spectra (biomass across size classes for all species and resource)
# - power = 2: scales the abundance spectrum to biomass (N(w) * w^2)
# Useful to assess size structure and whether any species dominate unrealistically
plotSpectra(params, power = 2)

# Plot model-predicted vs observed biomass (log-log scale by default)
# - ratio = FALSE (default): shows raw predicted vs observed biomass for each species
# Ideal results lie close to the 1:1 diagonal line
plotBiomassObservedVsModel(params)
```


# Set Sensitivity to Fishing

Check how model responses to fishing - resilience to fishing is influenced by the reproduction paramters being estimated by the steps above....


-Check ratio between modelled and obs catches, rescale catchability
-Adjust catchability, then setady state again

```{r}

# # get ratio of obs vs modelled yields, note sandlances are omitted so need to add in the vector with a 1 for sandlance
ratio <- c(plotYieldObservedVsModel(params, return_data = TRUE)$ratio[1:14], 1)

# rerun match biomass, growth, & steady, but this time also estimating catchabilities, using matchYield, needed to produce the species reported yields
# repeat below until minimising years to converge

for ( i in 1:10){
params<- params|> matchBiomasses()|> matchYield()|> steady()
}
 

plotYieldObservedVsModel(params, ratio = T)
plotBiomassObservedVsModel(params, ratio = T)


#check approx fishing mort not unrealistically large or small
gear_params(params)$catchability*initial_effort(params)

### adjust catcahbility for silver hake
gear_params(params)$catchability[9]<-1.8
# adjust catcahbility for dogfish
gear_params(params)$catchability[10]<-0.01
# adjust catcahbility for white hake
gear_params(params)$catchability[11]<-0.2
# catchability (and yields) too low for witch flounder
gear_params(params)$catchability[12]<-1
gear_params(params)$catchability[13]<-0.05
 

# adjust knfe edge size selectivity for silver hake
gear_params(params)$knife_edge_size[9]<-0.9*species_params(params)$w_mat[9]
# adjust knfe edge size for dogfish
gear_params(params)$knife_edge_size[10]<-1.2*species_params(params)$w_mat[10]
# adjust knife edge size for yellowtail
gear_params(params)$knife_edge_size[13]<-1.2*species_params(params)$w_mat[13]

# check converges in 1.5 years

for(i in 1:12){
# try to match to catch instead of biomass for problem species
params<-matchYields(params, species=c(9:13))
params<-matchBiomasses(params,species=c())
params<-steady(params)
}

# # check calibration plots again
plotYieldObservedVsModel(params, ratio = T,labels = F)
plotBiomassObservedVsModel(params,labels = F)

```

## Diagnostics: Now check steady state, again
```{r}
# Run the model to steady state and return the full simulation object
# - return_sim = TRUE: keeps the time series data (vs. just returning final params)
# - t_max = 100: allows up to 100 time steps to reach convergence
sim <- steady(params, return_sim = TRUE, t_max = 100)
# Quick plot of total biomass and yields over time (main summary)
plot(sim)

# Check Diagnostic plots
# Plot species biomass over time
# Useful to check if species stabilize or fluctuate at steady state
plotBiomass(sim)

# Plot spectra (biomass by size) from the final state
# Reveals trophic structure and size-based energy flow
plotSpectra(sim)

# Plot species diet composition by size
# Shows who eats whom across size classes
plotDiet(params)

# Plot growth curves for each species
# - species_panel = TRUE: shows separate panels per species
# - max_age = 20: restricts plots to ages up to 20
plotGrowthCurves(params, species_panel = TRUE, max_age = 20)

# Compare model vs observed yield (catch)
# - ratio = TRUE: visualizes model/observed ratio; ideal = 1
plotYieldObservedVsModel(params, ratio = TRUE)

# Compare model vs observed biomass
# - ratio = TRUE: visualizes model/observed ratio; ideal = 1
plotBiomassObservedVsModel(params, ratio = TRUE)

# Plot feeding level by size
# Reveals how full each species is at each size (0 = starving, 1 = satiated)
plotFeedingLevel(params)
```

Create size spectrum plots by species with size distribution data from DFO RV Trawl Surveys (q-corrected)

```{r}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load and reshape biomass-at-length to long format
# ------------------------------------------------------------
bio_size <- read.csv("Ess_data/Alida_Qadj_biomass_at_Length.csv.csv") |>
  pivot_longer(cols = !c(length_cm, YEAR),names_to = "Species", values_to     = "Biomass",
    values_drop_na = TRUE ) |>rename(Year = YEAR)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Recode species column names -> clean common names
# ------------------------------------------------------------
bio_size$Species <- factor(bio_size$Species, levels = c(
  "Sand.Lances", "Atlantic.Herring", "Atlantic.Cod",
  "Witch.Flounder", "American.Plaice", "Atlantic.Halibut",
  "Capelin", "Haddock", "Silver.Hake", "Yellowtail.Flounder",
  "Pollock", "Greenland.Halibut", "Atlantic.Mackerel",
  "Atlantic.Redfishes", "Spiny.Dogfish", "White.Hake"))

levels(bio_size$Species) <- c(
  "Sand Lances", "Atlantic Herring", "Atlantic Cod",
  "Witch Flounder", "American Plaice", "Atlantic Halibut",
  "Capelin", "Haddock", "Silver Hake", "Yellowtail Flounder",
  "Pollock", "Greenland Halibut", "Atlantic Mackerel",
  "Atlantic Redfishes", "Spiny Dogfish", "White Hake")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Check observed length range per species
# ------------------------------------------------------------
max_min_size <- bio_size |>
  group_by(Species) |>
  summarise(min_l = min(length_cm), max_l = max(length_cm))

print(max_min_size)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Join L-W parameters and compute weight
# ------------------------------------------------------------
wl <- data.frame(
  Species = species_params(params)$species,
  a       = species_params(params)$a,
  b       = species_params(params)$b)

bio_size <- bio_size |> left_join(wl, by = "Species") |> mutate(w = a * length_cm ^ b) |>
  filter(!is.na(Biomass), Year < 1986)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Bin into weight classes and normalise biomass
# ------------------------------------------------------------
breaks  <- 10 ^ seq(0, 6, 0.5)
upp     <- 10 ^ seq(0.5, 6,   0.5)
low     <- 10 ^ seq(0,   5.5, 0.5)
widths  <- upp - low
mid     <- (widths + 2 * widths) / 2   # midpoint of each bin

bio_size <- bio_size |>
  mutate(weightclass   = cut(w, breaks = breaks),
    norm_biomass  = Biomass / widths[as.integer(cut(w, breaks = breaks))])

levels(bio_size$weightclass) <- mid
bio_size$weightclass <- round(as.numeric(as.character(bio_size$weightclass)), 2)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Summarise: normalised biomass per weight class x year x species
# ------------------------------------------------------------
biomass_size_spectra <- bio_size |>
  group_by(weightclass, Year, Species) |>
  summarise(nbiomass = sum(norm_biomass), .groups = "drop")

mean_biomass_size_spectra <- biomass_size_spectra |>
  group_by(weightclass, Species) |>
  summarise(mean_nbiomass = mean(nbiomass), .groups = "drop")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Plot: mizer spectra + observed biomass size spectra
# ------------------------------------------------------------
size_distributions <- plotSpectra(params, power = 0, resource = FALSE) +
  geom_point(
    data = mean_biomass_size_spectra,
    aes(x = weightclass, y = mean_nbiomass, colour = Species)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Species) +
  labs(x = "Weight Class (g)", y = "Normalised Mean Biomass") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "none",
    axis.title.x     = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y     = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    panel.border     = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8)
  )

# size_distributions
ggsave(filename = paste0(save_dir, "Ess_Output/size_distributions.jpeg"), plot = size_distributions, width = 11, height = 8.5, units = "in",dpi = 400)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Shared colour palette for 16 species
# ------------------------------------------------------------
species_colours <- c(
  "#815f00", "#6237e2", "#8da600", "#de53ff", "#0e4300",
  "#430079", "#6caa72", "#ee0053", "#007957", "#b42979",
  "#142300", "#a08dfb", "#644500", "#00b4d8", "#e76f51", "#2a9d8f"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Shared theme
# ------------------------------------------------------------
calibration_theme <- theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, face = "bold", size = 8),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),

pb_yield <- mean(1 - Calibration_pb_yield$ratio, na.rm = TRUE)

Calibration_plot_Y <- ggplot(
  Calibration_pb_yield,
  aes(x = species, y = 1 - ratio, fill = species)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", width = 0.3, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = species_colours) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +

    x     = length(unique(Calibration_pb_biomass$species)) + 0.5,
    y     = max(1 - Calibration_pb_biomass$ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    label = expression(bold("(d)")),
    parse = TRUE, size = 3, hjust = 20.5, vjust = 1.1
  ) +
  labs(x = "Species", y = "1 - Modelled/Observed") +

# ------------------------------------------------------------

Calibration_plot <- combined_plot / (Calibration_plot_Y + Calibration_plot_B)
```

```{r}
params_with_seal <- params
new_gear_params <- data.frame(
  species = c(params_with_seal@species_params$species,params_with_seal@species_params$species),
  gear = c(gear_params(params_with_seal)$gear[1:16],rep("Seals",16)),

row.names(new_gear_params) <- row_names
gear_params(params_with_seal) <- new_gear_params
```
